finding.title: Zero-supply priced stablecoin component triggers zero denominator in weighted peg-deviation context

finding.mechanism: A valid zero-supply stablecoin component with price is included in priced because supply_share_of_tracked=0.0 is not None. When another positive-supply component has no price, tracked_supply>0 but every priced component has share 0.0, so the denominator sum(shares for priced) is zero; the conditional checks only whether priced is nonempty. Source predicts ZeroDivisionError instead of a valid descriptive context. This is downstream quality/availability, not A archive/integration or B source breadth.
